technicalSnippets: - NET_ADMIN # Для доступа к сетевым функциям
Description=Forward HAProxy Docker logs to syslog

actionban = curl -X POST --data-urlencode "payload={\"channel\": \"#security\", \"username\": \"fail2ban\", \"text\": \"Blocked IP: <ip> for attacking HAProxy\", \"icon_emoji\": \":police_car:\"}" https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR_SLACK_WEBHOOK
actionban = nft insert rule inet fail2ban <name> ip saddr <ip> counter drop
actioncheck = nft list chain inet fail2ban <name> >/dev/null 2>&1
actionstart = nft add table inet fail2ban
actionstop = nft delete chain inet fail2ban <name>
actionunban = nft delete rule inet fail2ban <name> ip saddr <ip> counter drop
docker logs -f haproxy --since=1m 2>&1 | while read line; do
docker logs -f haproxy 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO" | logger -t haproxy -p local0.info
grep "DD/Mon/YEAR:HH" /var/log/haproxy.log | awk '{ print $1 }' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
http-request deny if bad_request || bad_uri || bad_sql
nft add rule ip filter INPUT ip protocol tcp ip dport {<port>} jump <name>
stick-table type ip size 1m expire 1h store gpc0,conn_rate(3s),conn_cur,http_req_rate(10s),http_req_cnt,bytes_out_rate(10s)
stick-table type ip size 200k expire 30m store conn_rate(3s),http_req_rate(10s),http_err_rate(10s)
zcat /var/log/haproxy.log.1.gz | awk '{ print $1 }' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
